targets.rawSql:
WITH ForwardNeighborStats AS (
  SELECT node_id::text, COUNT(neighbor_id) AS forward_neighbor_count
  FROM node_neighbors
  GROUP BY node_id
),
ReverseNeighborStats AS (
  SELECT neighbor_id::text, COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) AS reverse_neighbor_count
  FROM node_neighbors
  GROUP BY neighbor_id
),
ActivityStats AS (
  SELECT 
    source_id::text, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (hop_start - hop_limit) = 0 THEN date_trunc('hour', time) END) AS direct_los_hours,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (hop_start - hop_limit) > 0 OR hop_start IS NULL THEN relay_node END) AS indirect_gateways
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY source_id
),
RelayStats AS (
  SELECT 
    rt::text AS relay_node_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.source_id) AS unique_tr_sources
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m, unnest(m.route_towards) AS rt
  WHERE m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP' 
    AND m.route_towards IS NOT NULL
    AND m.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND rt::text != m.source_id::text
    AND rt::text != m.destination_id::text
  GROUP BY rt::text
)
SELECT 
  n.long_name AS "Node Name",
  n.node_id AS "Node ID",
  COALESCE(n.role, 'CLIENT') AS "Current Role",
  
  -- NEW: MQTT Topic Extractions
  substring(n.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$') AS "Channel",
  TRIM(
    REPLACE(
      substring(n.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 
      'US/AZ/', 
      ''
    )
  ) AS "MQTT Region",
  
  -- THE FIREHOSE SCORE
  ROUND(
    (COALESCE(a.direct_los_hours, 0) * 8) + 
    (COALESCE(fns.forward_neighbor_count, 0) * 12) + 
    (COALESCE(rns.reverse_neighbor_count, 0) * 12) + 
    
    (SQRT(COALESCE(r.unique_tr_sources, 0)) * LEAST(COALESCE(fns.forward_neighbor_count, 0) + COALESCE(rns.reverse_neighbor_count, 0), 20)) +
    
    (COALESCE(a.indirect_gateways, 0) * 1)
  )::int AS "Promotion Score",
  
  (COALESCE(fns.forward_neighbor_count, 0) + COALESCE(rns.reverse_neighbor_count, 0)) AS "Total Neighbors",
  COALESCE(r.unique_tr_sources, 0) AS "Unique Users Routed",
  COALESCE(a.direct_los_hours, 0) AS "Direct LOS Hours"
  
FROM node_details n
JOIN ActivityStats a ON n.node_id::text = a.source_id
LEFT JOIN RelayStats r ON n.node_id::text = r.relay_node_id
LEFT JOIN ForwardNeighborStats fns ON n.node_id::text = fns.node_id
LEFT JOIN ReverseNeighborStats rns ON n.node_id::text = rns.neighbor_id
WHERE 
  (COALESCE(n.role, 'CLIENT') IN ('CLIENT', 'CLIENT_BASE'))
  AND (COALESCE(fns.forward_neighbor_count, 0) + COALESCE(rns.reverse_neighbor_count, 0)) >= 2 
ORDER BY 
  "Promotion Score" DESC;
